description: Use for "any edge on Kalshi" and "weather trade signals". Our model alerts on Kalshi — weather, bitcoin/silver/gold/oil, mispricings — with feed, tier, side, price, model probability, edge and link. Real time with Pro; free is delayed 24h without the thesis. One identical, impersonal feed for every subscriber; filters only select. Informational, not investment advice.

feed.description: Comma-separated feeds to include: weather, bitcoin, silver, gold, oil, mispricing, sports_arb, nfl. Omit for all.

limit.description: Max alerts to return (default 25). Values above 100 are clamped to 100.

min_tier.description: Minimum confidence tier (returns that tier and above).

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp — only alerts created after it.

name: edge_alerts
title: Edge Alerts (weather / commodity / mispricing)
